subject.title: Add persistent cron job execution history with filtering

question: Should OpenClaw expand cron history beyond the current SQLite `cron.runs` surface into timestamp-filtered CLI/protocol/export/summary/retention controls, and which pieces belong in core now?
rationale: The current gap is real, but the requested solution adds public CLI, protocol, config, export, and security-sensitive audit behavior rather than repairing a narrow broken contract.

options.title: Narrow Core History Upgrade
options.body: Add timestamp range filters through the existing SQLite/API/UI/CLI path, add JSON export and summary aggregates, and keep retention on the existing keepLines control unless a separate day-retention decision is made.

options.title: Full Audit Suite
options.body: Implement the complete request including follow, manual prune/vacuum, and day-based retention, accepting a larger public config and security review surface.

options.title: Keep Current Surface
options.body: Document that current `cron.runs`, UI filters, and keepLines pruning are the supported core history surface and leave advanced audit/reporting to external tooling.

recommendation.title: Narrow Core History Upgrade
recommendation.body: Add timestamp range filters through the existing SQLite/API/UI/CLI path, add JSON export and summary aggregates, and keep retention on the existing keepLines control unless a separate day-retention decision is made.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the most visible current routing candidate from the cron run-log source blame and issue discussion, with Takhoffman and gumadeiras as strong adjacent reviewers for UI/API and retention pieces.
